title: Acute Care Nurses
description: Provide advanced nursing care for patients with acute conditions such as heart attacks, respiratory distress syndrome, or shock. May care for pre- and post-operative patients or perform advanced, invasive diagnostic or therapeutic procedures.

projects: Complete foundational acute care nurses training
milestones: Discuss illnesses and treatments with patients and family members.Related occupations
Diagnose acute or chronic conditions that could result in rapid physiological deterioration or life-threatening instability.Related occupations
Perform emergency medical procedures, such as basic cardiac life support (BLS), advanced cardiac life support (ACLS), and other condition-stabilizing interventions.Related occupations
Assess urgent and emergent health conditions, using both physiologically and technologically derived data.Related occupations

Set up, operate, or monitor invasive equipment and devices, such as colostomy or tracheotomy equipment, mechanical ventilators, catheters, gastrointestinal tubes, and central lines.Related occupations
Document data related to patients' care, including assessment results, interventions, medications, patient responses, or treatment changes.Related occupations
Administer blood and blood product transfusions or intravenous infusions, monitoring patients for adverse reactions.Related occupations
Interpret information obtained from electrocardiograms (EKGs) or radiographs (x-rays).Related occupations
Perform administrative duties that facilitate admission, transfer, or discharge of patients.Related occupations

Senior.education: Bachelor's degree or higher + extensive experience
